title: A Next-Generation Defect Taxonomy for AI-Enhanced SEM-Based Semiconductor Inspection
content: The identification and categorization of defects in scanning electron microscope (SEM) images play a vital role in ensuring the quality and dependability of integrated circuits (ICs). As advancements in semiconductor technology continue, the types of defects arising from lithographic, etching, deposition, environmental, and stochastic processes become progressively intricate, influencing device yield, electrical functionality, and stability [1, 2]. An organized defect taxonomy improves defect recognition, streamlines manufacturing processes, and enhances the reliability of semiconductors. By merging this taxonomy with AI-driven approaches, defect detection transforms into a dynamic, self-optimizing system that boosts accuracy and productivity [3].
